- TrieSSTableWriter — SSTable write path (key index nested loops, MemorySegment alloc per entry)
- TrieSSTableReader — SSTable read path (eager data load, trie traversal, block cache)
- SpookyCompactor + MergeIterator — compaction merge (N-way heap, overlap scan)
- LocalWriteAheadLog — WAL write (fsync latency, writeLock contention)
- BlockedBloomFilter — bloom filter (hash + double-hash loop)
- LruBlockCache — block cache (ReentrantLock contention)
- LsmVectorIndex — SIMD distance computation
- DocumentSerializer — SIMD byte-swap encoding
